question: Do the held-out Trust policy and Default-compatible Capacity Operator produce a valid strategy ecology while retaining the behavior their names claim?

selectionRule.balance: Select only if every three-, four-, and five-player faction, seat, profile, diversity, fallback, and forced-no-op bound passes with no credible homogeneous or pairwise dominance.
selectionRule.trustIdentity: Trust Governor must select Influence on average, use it selectively rather than as its largest Core Action, and retain a competitive final Trust and Mandate result.
selectionRule.capacityIdentity: Capacity Operator must average at least two Build selections per appearance, then select Research plus Deploy more often than Build; otherwise the new name does not describe its behavior.
selectionRule.powerBoundary: Default Game may test local capacity operation but cannot claim Power-market brokerage. Advanced sales remain a separate future holdout.
selectionRule.rulesBoundary: Profile selection changes the evidence policy ecology and browser opponent labels, not physical rules.

requiredDiagnostics: profile Action selections and Mandate sources
profile and faction win shares by supported player count
AGI emergence and winner override rates
